_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Tampere (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 1 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from the operator's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

levels.name: Street / station-hall level (Rautatienkatu side, station hall, the tunnels under the tracks)
Platforms
levels.name_source: OSM: the railway platforms (relations 19521519, 19521688, 19521717, refs 1, 2;3, 4;5 as signposted) are tagged level 1, above the street-level hall and the tunnels under the tracks

sources.note: Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/fi_TPE).
Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/vayla_platforms_FI.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).

Corrected: the draft had taken the tram stops Koskipuisto A/B and Rautatieasema A/B (refs 0807–0810) as the station's platforms; now the railway platforms 1, 2–3 and 4–5 (OSM level 1, numbered as signposted and in Digitraffic) on a platform level above the hall.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 7 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_TPE).

1._source: Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0), Digitraffic infra-api laiturit 1.2.246.586.1.37.3322417, read 2026-10-30, CC BY 4.0: tracks 1, class korkea = 0.55 m above rail, 500 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey
